# Entry-level Software developer

📧 * ashkrao@gmail.com*
📞

*:house_with_garden:*

**425-615-4668**

**Redmond, WA**- Developer with excellent communication, time management, and problem-solving skills.
- Detail-oriented, fast learner, and team player.
- Experienced in project management.

| Domain | Skills |
|---|---|
| Programming | C#, OOP, data structures, algorithms, and SQL |
| Web development | Wordpress, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, |
| Operating Systems | OS X, Windows |
| Others | MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneNote), Visual Studio |

**Project:** Washington STEM (Aug 2016 – Present)

**Position:** Front-end developer

**Role:**

- Volunteering for washingtonstem.org - a non-profit driving innovation and improvement in STEM education in Washington state.
- Front-end development for career search and career trends features.
- Technologies used: ASP.NET, HTML, CSS

**Project:** #Hackforhealthcare hackathon (August 2016)

**Role:**
Part of a team that built a web app called RXBlueBook for cost analysis of prescription meds by chronic disease. https://github.com/RXBlueBook/mock_up.git

**Project:** OneWorld Now! (Mar 2016 – Aug 2016)

**Position:** Web developer

**Role:**

- Volunteered to build a web site for OneWorld Now! - a Seattle non-profit bringing international learning opportunities to underserved students.
- Collected requirements from client, organized the project work into manageable tasks and distributed work in the 4-person team.
- Followed Agile methodology with 2-week sprints with team communication on Slack.
- Utilized Lightbox for displaying images, developed the navigation menu, header and footer, stylized links on the homepage, and sidebar navigation cards.
- Technologies used: WordPress, HTML, CSS

**Project:** Ameego (Oct-2015 – Jan 2016)

**Role:**

- Developed and published the Ameego messaging app for Android.
- The app is based on Telegram APIs and has advanced features such as secret chat, group messaging, broadcast lists, stickers, and picture/video/file sharing.
- Google Play Store link: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.Ameego

Amazon Appstore link: http://amzn.com/B01A1UO5RW

**Project:** Hot metal detector / IR sensor for steel mill machinery.

**Position:** Lead Engineer

**Role:**

- Responsible for overall execution of the project.
- Trained and managed a team of 4 assistants.
- Translated high-level requirements into detailed product designs.
- Optimized the component mounting process with wave soldering, thereby reducing production time by 90%.
- Developed testing process for device accuracy to reduce the failure rate.

**Project:** Acoustic noise cancellation using Digital Signal Processing Kit.

**Position:** Engineering Intern.

**Role:** Worked as part of a four-member team to develop a proof-of-concept system to demonstrate noise cancellation technology with industrial applications.

*DeVry University, Atlanta,GA*

*National Institute of Engineering, Visveswaraiah Technological University, India.*
